item.description:
• When an update is available, the console shows "Update" and the menu bar icon and island get a small blue dot — one click to update
  • The update window now includes release notes in Chinese and English
  • Rebuilt Library window: centered, closes with a single click
  • Styles now show two rows; smoother "More" panel in the console

• 有新版本时控制台顶部显示「新版本」，菜单栏图标与灵动岛亮起小蓝点，点一下即可更新
  • 更新窗口附带中英版本说明
  • 片段库窗口重做：居中显示、一次点击即可关闭
  • 演出风格常驻两行，控制台「更多」展开更顺滑
